task.instruction: Check the leaderboard for Golf's DP World Tour in the SPORT section, what was the name of the most recent tournament, and how many teams have a Total of -10 strokes.

final_answer:
The most recent tournament on the DP World Tour leaderboard is the Genesis Championship. It ran 21–25 October 2026 at Woo Jeong Hills CC.

Seven players are tied on a total of -10 (274 strokes), in joint 4th place: Jorge Campillo, Antoine Rozner, Sang-Hun Shin, Casey Jarvis, Ryan Fox, Filippo Celli and Si-Woo Kim. The leaderboard lists individual players, not teams, so I counted players.

judge.rationale: The final page shows DP World Tour Genesis Championship and exactly seven entries with Total -10; the agent reported those facts.
